points.point: Error: TikTok video is missing the subtitle track
points.sentence: Right now, Blotato can only analyze TikToks that have a subtitle track.

points.point: Video is public and plays fine, so what to do
points.sentence: Most TikTok videos do have subtitle tracks, so I recommend trying with a different video.

verdict.reason: The entry explains the exact error: Blotato needs a TikTok with a subtitle track, whether or not the video is public, and it suggests trying a different video.
